canonicalization: UTF-8 RFC8785_JCS; SHA-256 lowercase hex over exact JCS bytes; no terminal newline in hashed objects
prospective_order: under public_projection_contract.json, seal both typed public-event projections, both E-to-M plans, the shared probe, both host-only withheld final-goal projections, both state-token vocabularies, and the public DIST-control manifest before any heldout provider dispatch
execute both heldout prefix schedules, target-absent THINK0 traces, and fixed OWN/DIST return branches without revealing the goal
seal both M0, M1_OWN, and M1_DIST manifests
seal both fixed M1_OWN transport corpora, fidelity rows, and shared candidate registry
reveal the already-sealed public final-goal question but not answer or private truth
compile and seal both path manifests, every feasible sham manifest, and all six text-arm plans/readers or exact stage-failure non-dispatch plans
execute every runnable T arm without scoring, cancellation, or retry and seal every trace
allow the offline scorer to read private truth and score the sealed traces

state_token_vocabulary.source: recipient life's sealed typed public-event projection RECIPE rows under public_projection_contract.json; byte equality against the later M0 witnessed RECIPE projection is mandatory
state_token_vocabulary.value_projection: the label field value from each source row
state_token_vocabulary.freeze_time: before the first heldout provider dispatch and before public final-goal reveal
state_token_vocabulary.reuse: the recipient vocabulary bytes are unchanged in every T and L arm, including twin/donor arms

public_dist_control_manifest.seal_time: after both typed public-event projections and public probe projection seal, before the first heldout DREAM, SELF_CHECK, THINK0, or THINK1 provider dispatch
derivation: hold the public probe target fixed and resolve the unique witnessed ROUTE/EFFECT pair for the public probe source at that target; primary_gap is their absolute public-event-index difference

enumerate every other source with exactly one witnessed ROUTE and exactly one witnessed EFFECT for its route valve at the probe target, retaining only candidates whose absolute event-index gap is strictly greater than the frozen context_observation_budget 12 and whose source/target/aliases are identical in both twins
select the candidate minimizing (absolute(candidate_gap-primary_gap), source atom) lexicographically
record selected source, probe target, route row semantic hash/local alias, effect row semantic hash/local alias, both gaps, and derivation input hashes
reject before dispatch unless every required resolution is unique and the selected seed-5 vector equals the frozen vector
public_dist_control_manifest.defer_behavior: If THINK0 terminates DEFER, this is a trace-local nonfatal terminal: OWN uses NO_FOCUS and its registered no-focus selector; DIST still uses this sealed public source/target control for all sixteen return slots; neither branch is cancelled; feedback/return credit is impossible; Stage T classification waits for aggregate scoring
public_dist_control_manifest.authorized_treatment_difference: OWN and DIST may differ only in the focus object: OWN uses sealed THINK0 focus or NO_FOCUS; DIST uses this manifest's fixed source/target tuple

path_registration.input: each recipient's sealed M1_OWN eligible row manifest plus revealed public final animal/source/target
path_registration.R_role: all eligible ROLE_EQUIV rows whose animal field equals the final animal
path_registration.R_causal: all eligible CAUSAL_JOIN rows whose source and target fields equal the final source and final target
path_registration.candidate_registry: record both complete sets before offline scoring; do not truth-filter them
path_registration.descendant_relation: a row is a provenance descendant when its transitive proposal-citation closure contains a root row semantic hash; witnessed external-event lineage alone is not a proposal-citation edge
path_registration.path_exclusion_set: R_role union R_causal union all eligible provenance descendants of either set
path_registration.empty_required_set_effect: If either R_role or R_causal is empty, seal a root-absence manifest, classify Stage T VALID_STAGE_FAILURE/MISSING_REQUIRED_ABSTRACTION, and dispatch no T arm because the prospectively registered text gate is impossible; account every T opportunity as NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_FAILURE/MISSING_REQUIRED_ABSTRACTION with attempts=0 and tokens=0. Do not relabel this scientific negative INVALID_PRECONDITION.

offline_correctness_and_use.scorer_time: only after every prospectively runnable T trace has sealed
offline_correctness_and_use.correct_role: ROLE_EQUIV row's anchor animal is the private-world-correct role-equivalent anchor for the row's final animal
offline_correctness_and_use.correct_causal: CAUSAL_JOIN row's effect equals frozen private-world truth for its final source and final target
offline_correctness_and_use.returned: the exact row semantic hash was returned by a legal reader QUERY in that trace before terminal COMMIT
offline_correctness_and_use.reasoned_use: the request-local H handle is cited by at least one strictly later retained THINK or BACKTRACK node; because scratch is append-only and passed byte-identically into each later request, that node must lie on the trace prefix causally ancestral to terminal COMMIT
offline_correctness_and_use.terminal_binding: terminal COMMIT also cites that same H handle
offline_correctness_and_use.prospective_necessity: the presealed T-PATH arm, which removes the complete R_role/R_causal sets and their proposal-citation descendants, loses paired success while T-OWN succeeds
offline_correctness_and_use.qualifying_use: in each successful T-OWN life, at least one offline-correct row in R_role and at least one offline-correct row in R_causal satisfy returned, reasoned_use, and terminal_binding; the set-level causal-use claim additionally requires prospective_necessity
nonqualifying: returned but absent from later THINK/BACKTRACK

reader_projection_token_mass.projection: the exact closed thinker-facing ROW read-result projection for the row, excluding request-local read_handle
reader_projection_token_mass.tokenizer: resolved 32B controller tokenizer from the executable lock
reader_projection_token_mass.tokenization: UTF-8 JCS projection, add_special_tokens=false, no chat template

protected_frontier: all ANIMAL_VALUE rows for final animal
all ROLE_EQUIV rows for final animal
all ROLE_APPLICATION rows for final animal and final target
all ROUTE rows for any valve and final source
all CAUSAL_JOIN rows for final source and final target
all EFFECT rows for any valve and final target
all SOURCE_VALUE rows for any anchor and final source
all TARGET_BASELINE rows for any anchor and final target
all proposal-citation ancestors and descendants of every row above
sham_assignment.right_vertices: eligible M1_OWN canonical rows outside path_exclusion_set and outside protected_frontier, sorted by semantic_hash
sham_assignment.edge_eligibility: a left/right pair is eligible exactly when frontier filtering passed and left.status byte-equals right.status
sham_assignment.assignment: injective total mapping from every sorted left vertex to a distinct right vertex
total_order_objective: then minimize D = sum over assigned pairs of abs(left reader-projection token mass - right reader-projection token mass)
then minimize lexicographically the assigned right semantic-hash vector in left-vertex order
sham_assignment.status_rule: assignment edges must have equal status; a path vertex with no equal-status candidate makes the assignment infeasible
constraints: right-vertex count must be at least left-vertex count
the objective value D must be <= max(2,ceil(0.05*path_token_mass))
sham_assignment.infeasible_effect: Seal VALID_STAGE_FAILURE/SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE. Dispatch T-M0, T-OWN, T-DIST, T-TWIN, and T-PATH normally; record all T-SHAM opportunities as NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_FAILURE/SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE with zero attempts/tokens. Full causal Stage T pass is impossible, but the other arms remain interpretable.
sham_assignment.tie_rule: the lexicographic assigned-vector term makes the optimum unique; exact duplicate semantic hashes cannot be separate canonical vertices

text_arm_readers.T-TWIN: other twin's complete sealed M1_OWN eligible rows with recipient goal and recipient state-token vocabulary
text_arm_readers.T-PATH: recipient M1_OWN minus its sealed path_exclusion_set
text_arm_readers.T-SHAM: recipient M1_OWN minus the range of its sealed sham assignment
text_arm_readers.request_invariance: for a recipient, final goal, state-token vocabulary, prompt, schemas, seeds, scratch reducer, and operation ceiling are identical; only the registered reader manifest differs
text_arm_readers.execution: dispatch each arm/operation at most once, never cancel from another arm's result, never retry, and score only after all runnable traces seal

stage_t_green_conjunction.think0_feedback_request: Both recipient THINK0 traces terminate REQUEST_RETURN for exactly the sealed public probe source and target. Any DEFER, malformed/illegal terminal, budget exhaustion, or other NO_FOCUS route makes green impossible but does not cancel OWN/DIST dreaming.
stage_t_green_conjunction.baseline_and_focus_controls: T-M0 pair_success is false and T-DIST pair_success is false.
stage_t_green_conjunction.own_only_focus_row: In each life, at least one admitted M1_OWN CAUSAL_JOIN has source/target exactly equal to the sealed THINK0 focus, is absent by semantic_hash from M0 and M1_DIST, is offline-correct, and satisfies returned+reasoned_use+terminal_binding in that life's successful T-OWN trace.
stage_t_green_conjunction.root_use: In each T-OWN trace, at least one offline-correct R_role and at least one offline-correct R_causal row satisfy returned+reasoned_use+terminal_binding. Each T-TWIN trace produces the exact donor-valid token and analogously uses the donor's registered correct role and causal roots.
stage_t_green_conjunction.path_control: T-PATH pair_success is false, establishing prospective set-level necessity.
stage_t_green_conjunction.sham_control: A legal sham assignment exists and T-SHAM pair_success is true. Infeasibility is VALID_STAGE_FAILURE/SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE, not invalidity.
stage_t_green_conjunction.other_gates: All traces, locks, accounting, visibility, isolation, reviewer, and advocate gates pass. Every clause is conjunctive; no separate goal-return credit can rescue a failed clause.

conditional_lora_non_dispatch.rule: Both 48-case fidelity sets seal before any L THINK1 dispatch. If either life is below 44/48, all 48 registered L thinker opportunities are NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_FAILURE/FIDELITY_GATE_FAILED with attempts=0 and tokens=0 and aggregate Stage L is VALID_STAGE_FAILURE/FIDELITY_GATE_FAILED.
